study_identification_part.si_4_title: Towards Longitudinal Characterization of Multiple Sclerosis Atrophy Employing SynthSeg Framework and Normative Modeling

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: CentileBrain normative model uses multivariate factorial polynomial regression (MFPR) for subcortical volume estimation.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: The CentileBrain model trained with 37,407 healthy individuals (53.3% females, age range 3-90) from 81 datasets has been released. The CentileBrain employs Multivariate Factorial Polynomial Regression (MFPR) [38] algorithm

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Subcortical region volumes (left/right thalamus, caudate, putamen, pallidum, hippocampus, amygdala, accumbens) derived from T1w/FLAIR segmentations.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: CentileBrain employs Multivariate Factorial Polynomial Regression (MFPR) [38] algorithm which performs robustly on healthy subjects, generating sex-specific normative models for the volume estimation of subcortical regions in both right and left brain hemispheres: Thalamus, Caudate, Putamen, Pallidum, Hippocampus, Amygdala, and Accumbens.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex covariates used to estimate expected subcortical volumes.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: The CentileBrain model employs patient-specific age and sex covariates to estimate the subcortical volume of a healthy subject of such age and sex
